claim_assessment: All engineering bugs fixed (V21-V27). Core blocker confirmed: Data Distribution Shift — Infinigen gripper signals are continuous-gradual while MINT VQ-VAE expects discrete binary. Teacher data grasp_steps=1-2 but criteria requires >=5. Three fix options identified: Dataset Wrapper (10min), AnyGrasp regeneration (2-3h), or criteria adjustment (5min).
strengths: All V21-V27 engineering bugs fixed: inplace ops, decoder unfreeze, dtype mismatch, checkpoint finding
VQ-VAE decoder is now trainable and updates (140/153 weights changed)
Finetuned model produces 8.6x more EEF motion than pretrained (16.3m vs 1.9m)
Quantizer updated in training (codebook entries 369/419/124/179 changed)
Model learns motion successfully, only gripper close is missing
weaknesses: Data Distribution Shift: Infinigen gripper is continuous-gradual, MINT expects discrete binary (-1/+1)
Teacher data grasp_steps=1-2 but strict_rollout_criteria requires >=5
direct_grip_head learns to always predict OPEN (bias=+0.008, sigmoid~0.5)
VQ-VAE quantizer loses gripper timing info in small dataset (499 frames, 512 codebook)

root_causes.issue: Teacher data vs evaluation criteria mismatch
root_causes.detail: grasp_steps=1-2 in teacher data, but strict_rollout_criteria requires >=5
Infinigen: gripper 1.0->-1.0 is smooth transition (~5 steps). MINT: expects instant -1/+1 binary switch.
512 codebook entries insufficient to preserve gripper timing in small dataset (499 frames)
Bias +0.008 leads to sigmoid~0.5, always predicts OPEN, never closes gripper

next_actions: 方案A (immediate): Implement Dataset Wrapper — gripper binarization, action scaling to match LIBERO (~10 min)
方案B (correct long-term): Regenerate AnyGrasp data — force gripper -1.0 for >=5 steps at contact (2-3h GPU)
方案C (quick test): Adjust strict_rollout_criteria — lower grasp_steps_gte from 5 to match data (~5 min)
Recommendation: Start with 方案C (fastest validation), then proceed to 方案A if needed
